answer.rationale: The incumbent has refused a price reopen and the contract lapses in 14 days with no auto-renew, so renew, defer, or a dual-source add would miss the 18% spend mandate or leave primary supply uncovered. The low-cost quote is the only path that hits the cut on its own. memory_c2 is the sole support that a primary move to that vendor can be onboarded quickly with clean invoicing; that claim is high-stakes and will be verified. memory_c1 plus a 94% loaded line with no buffer means a full cutover can still raise delivery risk, which is flagged rather than assumed away. memory_c4’s renegotiation lever is already blocked by the refusal, so it is not the one action this cycle.
